subject: expression: replace equal condition by true when to constant propagation (#64309)
summary: Updates constant propagation to rewrite redundant predicates implied by established column equalities: (1) replaces repeated/transitively-implied `col = col` conditions with TRUE, and (2) replaces some `IN` / nested AND/OR subexpressions with TRUE when one side is guaranteed to match an `IN` element, while explicitly skipping string-typed `IN` to avoid collation-derivation semantics traps. Planner/expression tests and collation integration coverage are updated accordingly.
